title: How Brain Teasers Brain Games Took Over So Fast
hook: Brain is a 2021 edutainment party video game developed by
script:
Brain is a 2021 edutainment party video game developed by Nintendo EPD and published by Nintendo.
That is not a guess – it is what the science actually says.
The game released on December 3, 2021 for the Nintendo Switch.
It is the third entry in the Big Brain Academy series, following the release of Big Brain Academy (2005) and Big Brain Academy: Wii Degree (2007) over a decade later.
And that is the real story of Brain Teasers | Brain Games.
